title: The Paper
summary: A fragmented memoir about forms, signatures, categories, and the distance between recording an event and actually responding to it. The paper becomes complete while the person's request remains unresolved.

reality_weaving.imaginative_transformation: The workplace and closed-institution readings remain simultaneously plausible. Forms, signatures, blank fields, and procedural language gradually replace the person's own account.
reality_weaving.emergent_question: What happens to a person's experience when the form becomes more complete than the life it is meant to record?

links.note: The previous chapter's voices become written statements, summaries, and unanswered questions.
The next chapter carries the blank spaces and unresolved request into a larger absence.

tr.title: Kâğıt
tr.summary: Formlar, imzalar ve boş alanlar üzerinden insanın yaşadığı şey ile kayda geçirilmesi gereken şey arasındaki mesafeyi anlatan parçalı bir bölüm.

en.title: The Paper
en.summary: A fragmented chapter about forms, signatures, blank fields, and the distance between a person's experience and what the record can contain.
